ko.title: 세 가지 오류, 수백만 명의 대출자: 공공 서비스 대출 탕감(PSLF) 크레딧 회수의 배경

segments.src: ## A Program Built on Counting Correctly
segments.tr: ## 정확한 계산을 기반으로 구축된 프로그램

segments.src: Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) has always hinged on one simple-sounding task: counting payments.
segments.tr: 공공 서비스 대출 탕감(PSLF) 프로그램은 항상 '결제 횟수 계산'이라는 단순해 보이는 작업에 달려 있었습니다.

segments.src: Borrowers who work full-time for a qualifying government or nonprofit employer are supposed to have their loans forgiven after 120 qualifying monthly payments.
segments.tr: 자격을 갖춘 정부 기관이나 비영리 단체에서 풀타임으로 근무하는 대출자는 120회의 적격 월별 상환을 완료하면 대출을 탕감받아야 합니다.

segments.src: In practice, tracking those 120 payments across different loan servicers, repayment plans, and employment records has proven anything but simple — and the Education Department says a chunk of the credit borrowers were given in recent years does not hold up under closer review.
segments.tr: 실제로 서로 다른 대출 서비스 기관, 상환 계획, 고용 기록에 걸쳐 120회의 상환을 추적하는 것은 결코 간단하지 않았습니다. 교육부는 최근 몇 년간 대출자들에게 부여된 크레딧 중 상당 부분이 면밀한 검토 결과 사실과 다르다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: According to the department, corrections now being made to borrower accounts stem from a handful of recurring counting errors rather than a single sweeping policy reversal.
segments.tr: 교육부에 따르면, 현재 대출자 계좌에 대해 이루어지고 있는 수정 사항은 단일한 정책의 전면적인 뒤집기가 아니라 반복되는 몇 가지 계산 오류에서 비롯된 것입니다.

segments.src: Understanding what those errors are — and what they mean for someone checking their own loan dashboard — is more useful than treating the headlines as a verdict on any one borrower's progress.
segments.tr: 이러한 오류가 무엇인지, 그리고 자신의 대출 대시보드를 확인하는 사람들에게 어떤 의미가 있는지 이해하는 것이, 뉴스 헤드라인을 특정 대출자의 진행 상황에 대한 판결로 받아들이는 것보다 더 유용합니다.

segments.src: ## Where the Errors Reportedly Came From
segments.tr: ## 오류의 발생 원인

segments.src: Loan servicing records point to three broad categories of mistakes that inflated payment counts during the program's rapid expansion:
segments.tr: 대출 서비스 기록에 따르면 프로그램이 급격히 확대되는 과정에서 상환 횟수를 부풀린 세 가지 주요 오류 범주가 지적되었습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Forbearance and deferment periods counted as payments.** Some months when borrowers were not actually required to pay — because they were steered into forbearance or certain deferment statuses — were still logged as qualifying months. Regulators and consumer advocates flagged this "forbearance steering" problem in earlier reviews of student loan servicing broadly, and officials say some of that residue carried into PSLF tallies.
segments.tr: 1. **유예 및 연기 기간이 상환으로 계산됨.** 대출자가 유예(forbearance)나 특정 연기(deferment) 상태로 유도되어 실제로 상환할 필요가 없었던 일부 기간이 적격 월로 기록되었습니다. 규제 당국과 소비자 보호 단체들은 학자금 대출 서비스에 대한 초기 검토에서 이러한 "유예 유도(forbearance steering)" 문제를 지적했으며, 관계자들은 그 잔재 중 일부가 PSLF 집계에 반영되었다고 말합니다.

segments.src: 2. **Repayment-plan mismatches.** PSLF only counts payments made under qualifying plans, generally income-driven repayment or the standard 10-year plan. When borrowers moved between plans — sometimes automatically, sometimes at a servicer's suggestion — a portion of months were credited that shouldn't have been under the program's rules.
segments.tr: 2. **상환 계획 불일치.** PSLF는 일반적으로 소득 기반 상환(IDR)이나 표준 10년 상환 계획과 같이 자격을 갖춘 계획에 따른 상환만 계산합니다. 대출자가 계획을 변경할 때(때로는 자동으로, 때로는 서비스 기관의 제안에 따라), 프로그램 규칙상 포함되지 말아야 할 일부 기간이 크레딧으로 인정되었습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Employer certification and consolidation timing issues.** Consolidating multiple federal loans can reset a payment count unless handled carefully, and employer certifications that overlapped or contained gaps sometimes produced credit for periods that do not actually meet the program's continuous full-time employment standard.
segments.tr: 3. **고용주 인증 및 통합 시기 문제.** 여러 연방 대출을 통합할 때 주의하지 않으면 상환 횟수가 초기화될 수 있으며, 고용주 인증 기간이 겹치거나 공백이 있는 경우 프로그램의 지속적인 풀타임 고용 기준을 실제로 충족하지 않는 기간에 대해 크레딧이 생성되기도 했습니다.

segments.src: Officials describe these as data and processing issues compounded by the sheer volume of applications processed after temporary waivers expanded PSLF eligibility a few years ago, rather than an attempt to strip borrowers of credit they legitimately earned.
segments.tr: 관계자들은 이를 대출자가 정당하게 획득한 크레딧을 박탈하려는 시도가 아니라, 몇 년 전 임시 면제 조치로 PSLF 자격이 확대된 후 처리된 방대한 신청량으로 인해 발생한 데이터 및 처리 문제라고 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Borrowers
segments.tr: ## 대출자에게 미치는 영향

segments.src: For most people enrolled in PSLF, this is unlikely to mean starting over.
segments.tr: PSLF에 등록된 대부분의 사람들에게 이것이 처음부터 다시 시작해야 함을 의미할 가능성은 낮습니다.

segments.src: The department has indicated that corrections apply to a subset of accounts where specific errors were identified, not to every borrower's count.
segments.tr: 교육부는 이번 수정 사항이 모든 대출자의 계산이 아닌, 특정 오류가 확인된 일부 계좌에만 적용된다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty itself is a real cost: borrowers who believed they were close to their 120th payment may find their online tracker shows fewer qualifying months than before, and that can complicate financial planning, job decisions, or timing around other debt.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 불확실성 자체가 실질적인 비용입니다. 120회 상환에 거의 도달했다고 믿었던 대출자들은 온라인 추적기에 표시된 적격 월수가 이전보다 줄어든 것을 발견할 수 있으며, 이는 재무 계획, 직업 결정 또는 기타 부채 상환 일정에 차질을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Consumer advocates recommend borrowers take a few concrete steps rather than assume the worst:
segments.tr: 소비자 보호 단체들은 최악의 상황을 가정하기보다 대출자들이 다음과 같은 구체적인 조치를 취할 것을 권장합니다:

segments.src: - **Check your official PSLF count** through the Federal Student Aid dashboard, and compare it against your own payment history if you've kept records.
segments.tr: - **공식 PSLF 횟수를 확인하세요.** 연방 학자금 지원(Federal Student Aid) 대시보드를 통해 확인하고, 기록을 보관해 두었다면 본인의 상환 내역과 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: - **Save documentation** of employer certifications, pay stubs, and correspondence with your servicer — these matter most if you need to dispute a change.
segments.tr: - **문서를 저장하세요.** 고용주 인증서, 급여 명세서, 서비스 기관과의 서신 등은 변경 사항에 대해 이의를 제기해야 할 때 가장 중요합니다.

segments.src: - **Contact your loan servicer directly** if your count drops unexpectedly, and ask specifically which months were affected and why.
segments.tr: - **대출 서비스 기관에 직접 문의하세요.** 횟수가 예상치 못하게 줄어들었다면, 어떤 달이 영향을 받았는지, 그 이유는 무엇인지 구체적으로 물어보세요.

segments.src: - **Watch for official communications** from the Education Department or your servicer rather than relying solely on social media summaries, since the details of any correction process can change as it's implemented.
segments.tr: - **공식 통신을 주시하세요.** 소셜 미디어 요약에만 의존하지 말고 교육부나 서비스 기관의 공식 발표를 확인하세요. 수정 절차의 세부 사항은 실행 과정에서 변경될 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: PSLF has been recalibrated more than once since it was created in 2007, including a temporary limited waiver during the pandemic era that allowed many previously ineligible payments to count.
segments.tr: PSLF는 2007년 도입 이후 팬데믹 기간 동안 이전에 자격이 없던 많은 상환을 인정해 준 한시적 제한 면제 조치를 포함하여 여러 차례 재조정되었습니다.

segments.src: Corrections like these are, in part, the flip side of that expansion — a system that quickly granted broad credit is now being reconciled against the program's original rules.
segments.tr: 이러한 수정은 부분적으로는 그러한 확대의 이면입니다. 즉, 광범위한 크레딧을 신속하게 부여했던 시스템이 이제 프로그램의 원래 규칙에 맞춰 조정되고 있는 것입니다.

segments.src: For borrowers, the practical takeaway is patience paired with vigilance: verify your own numbers where possible, keep paperwork, and treat any change to your count as a starting point for a conversation with your servicer rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: 대출자에게 실질적인 조언은 인내심을 갖고 경계하는 것입니다. 가능한 경우 본인의 숫자를 직접 확인하고, 서류를 보관하며, 횟수 변경 사항을 최종 결과가 아닌 서비스 기관과의 대화를 시작하는 출발점으로 삼으십시오.

segments.src: As the department continues reviewing accounts, more specifics are expected to emerge about how many borrowers are affected and what appeal options exist for those who believe their credit was corrected in error.
segments.tr: 교육부가 계좌 검토를 계속함에 따라, 얼마나 많은 대출자가 영향을 받는지, 그리고 크레딧이 잘못 수정되었다고 믿는 사람들을 위한 이의 제기 옵션은 무엇인지에 대한 구체적인 내용이 더 나올 것으로 예상됩니다.

zh.title: 三大故障，数百万借款人：公共服务贷款豁免学分缩减背后的真相

segments.src: ## A Program Built on Counting Correctly
segments.tr: ## 一个建立在精确计数基础上的计划

segments.src: Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) has always hinged on one simple-sounding task: counting payments.
segments.tr: 公共服务贷款豁免（PSLF）始终围绕着一项听起来很简单的工作：计算还款次数。

segments.src: Borrowers who work full-time for a qualifying government or nonprofit employer are supposed to have their loans forgiven after 120 qualifying monthly payments.
segments.tr: 为符合条件的政府或非营利组织雇主全职工作的借款人，在按要求完成 120 次符合条件的月度还款后，其贷款应获得豁免。

segments.src: In practice, tracking those 120 payments across different loan servicers, repayment plans, and employment records has proven anything but simple — and the Education Department says a chunk of the credit borrowers were given in recent years does not hold up under closer review.
segments.tr: 但在实践中，跨越不同的贷款服务机构、还款计划和雇佣记录来追踪这 120 次还款绝非易事——教育部表示，借款人近年来获得的一部分还款计数学分在更严格的审查下并未通过考验。

segments.src: According to the department, corrections now being made to borrower accounts stem from a handful of recurring counting errors rather than a single sweeping policy reversal.
segments.tr: 据教育部称，目前对借款人账户进行的更正源于少数反复出现的计数错误，而非单项重大的政策逆转。

segments.src: Understanding what those errors are — and what they mean for someone checking their own loan dashboard — is more useful than treating the headlines as a verdict on any one borrower's progress.
segments.tr: 了解这些错误是什么——以及它们对正在查看自己贷款仪表板的人意味着什么——比将头条新闻视为对任何特定借款人进展的最终判决更有用。

segments.src: ## Where the Errors Reportedly Came From
segments.tr: ## 据报道错误来自何处

segments.src: Loan servicing records point to three broad categories of mistakes that inflated payment counts during the program's rapid expansion:
segments.tr: 贷款服务记录指向三大类错误，这些错误在该计划快速扩张期间虚增了还款计数：

segments.src: 1. **Forbearance and deferment periods counted as payments.** Some months when borrowers were not actually required to pay — because they were steered into forbearance or certain deferment statuses — were still logged as qualifying months. Regulators and consumer advocates flagged this "forbearance steering" problem in earlier reviews of student loan servicing broadly, and officials say some of that residue carried into PSLF tallies.
segments.tr: 1. **缓缴和延期期间被计为还款。** 一些借款人实际上并不需要还款的月份（因为他们被引导进入缓缴或某些延期状态）仍被记录为符合条件的月份。监管机构和消费者倡导者在早期对学生贷款服务的广泛审查中就指出了这种“引导缓缴”问题，官员表示其中一些遗留问题影响到了 PSLF 的统计。

segments.src: 2. **Repayment-plan mismatches.** PSLF only counts payments made under qualifying plans, generally income-driven repayment or the standard 10-year plan. When borrowers moved between plans — sometimes automatically, sometimes at a servicer's suggestion — a portion of months were credited that shouldn't have been under the program's rules.
segments.tr: 2. **还款计划不匹配。** PSLF 仅计算在符合条件的计划下完成的还款，通常是按收入结算还款计划或标准 10 年还款计划。当借款人在不同计划之间切换时（有时是自动切换，有时是在服务机构的建议下切换），根据该计划的规定，一部分本不应被计入的月份被赋予了学分。

segments.src: 3. **Employer certification and consolidation timing issues.** Consolidating multiple federal loans can reset a payment count unless handled carefully, and employer certifications that overlapped or contained gaps sometimes produced credit for periods that do not actually meet the program's continuous full-time employment standard.
segments.tr: 3. **雇主认证和合并贷款的时间点问题。** 除非谨慎处理，否则合并多笔联邦贷款可能会重置还款计数；此外，重叠或存在空档期的雇主认证有时会导致某些实际上不符合该计划持续全职雇佣标准的时期获得了学分。

segments.src: Officials describe these as data and processing issues compounded by the sheer volume of applications processed after temporary waivers expanded PSLF eligibility a few years ago, rather than an attempt to strip borrowers of credit they legitimately earned.
segments.tr: 官员们将这些描述为数据和处理问题，由于几年前临时豁免扩大了 PSLF 资格后处理的大量申请而雪上加霜，而不是试图剥夺借款人合法获得的学分。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Borrowers
segments.tr: ## 这对借款人意味着什么

segments.src: For most people enrolled in PSLF, this is unlikely to mean starting over.
segments.tr: 对大多数参与 PSLF 的人来说，这不太可能意味着要重头来过。

segments.src: The department has indicated that corrections apply to a subset of accounts where specific errors were identified, not to every borrower's count.
segments.tr: 教育部已表明，更正仅适用于识别出具体错误的子集账户，而不是针对每位借款人的计数。

segments.src: Still, uncertainty itself is a real cost: borrowers who believed they were close to their 120th payment may find their online tracker shows fewer qualifying months than before, and that can complicate financial planning, job decisions, or timing around other debt.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，不确定性本身就是一种实际成本：以为自己即将完成第 120 次还款的借款人可能会发现，他们的在线追踪器显示的符合条件的月份比以前少了，这可能会使财务规划、职业抉择或其他债务的时间安排变得更加复杂。

segments.src: Consumer advocates recommend borrowers take a few concrete steps rather than assume the worst:
segments.tr: 消费者倡导者建议借款人采取一些具体的应对步骤，而不是作最坏的打算：

segments.src: - **Check your official PSLF count** through the Federal Student Aid dashboard, and compare it against your own payment history if you've kept records.
segments.tr: - **检查你的官方 PSLF 计数**，通过 Federal Student Aid 仪表板查看，如果你保留了记录，请将其与你自己的还款历史进行对比。

segments.src: - **Save documentation** of employer certifications, pay stubs, and correspondence with your servicer — these matter most if you need to dispute a change.
segments.tr: - **保存证明文件**，包括雇主认证、工资单以及与服务机构的通信记录——如果你需要对变更提出异议，这些是最重要的。

segments.src: - **Contact your loan servicer directly** if your count drops unexpectedly, and ask specifically which months were affected and why.
segments.tr: - **如果你的计数意外下降，直接联系你的贷款服务机构**，并具体询问哪些月份受到了影响以及原因。

segments.src: - **Watch for official communications** from the Education Department or your servicer rather than relying solely on social media summaries, since the details of any correction process can change as it's implemented.
segments.tr: - **关注官方通信**，留意来自教育部或你的服务机构的信息，而不是仅依赖社交媒体上的总结，因为任何更正流程的细节在实施过程中都可能发生变化。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 大局观

segments.src: PSLF has been recalibrated more than once since it was created in 2007, including a temporary limited waiver during the pandemic era that allowed many previously ineligible payments to count.
segments.tr: 自 2007 年设立以来，PSLF 已经历过多次调整，包括疫情期间的一项临时有限豁免，该豁免允许许多以前不符合条件的还款被计入。

segments.src: Corrections like these are, in part, the flip side of that expansion — a system that quickly granted broad credit is now being reconciled against the program's original rules.
segments.tr: 像这样的更正，在某种程度上正是那次扩张的另一面——一个迅速给予广泛学分的系统现在正在根据该计划的原始规则进行对账。

segments.src: For borrowers, the practical takeaway is patience paired with vigilance: verify your own numbers where possible, keep paperwork, and treat any change to your count as a starting point for a conversation with your servicer rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: 对于借款人来说，切实可行的做法是保持耐心的同时保持警惕：尽可能核实你自己的数据，保留文件，并将计数的任何变化视为与你的服务机构沟通的起点，而不是最终答案。

segments.src: As the department continues reviewing accounts, more specifics are expected to emerge about how many borrowers are affected and what appeal options exist for those who believe their credit was corrected in error.
segments.tr: 随着教育部继续审查账户，预计关于受影响的借款人数量以及那些认为自己学分被错误更正的人拥有何种申诉选项的更多细节将会浮出水面。

segments.src: ## A Program Built on Counting Correctly
segments.tr: ## सही गणना पर आधारित एक कार्यक्रम

segments.src: Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) has always hinged on one simple-sounding task: counting payments.
segments.tr: पब्लिक सर्विस लोन फॉरगिवनेस (PSLF) हमेशा से एक सरल लगने वाले कार्य पर टिका रहा है: भुगतान की गिनती करना।

segments.src: Borrowers who work full-time for a qualifying government or nonprofit employer are supposed to have their loans forgiven after 120 qualifying monthly payments.
segments.tr: जो उधारकर्ता किसी योग्य सरकारी या गैर-लाभकारी नियोक्ता के लिए पूर्णकालिक काम करते हैं, उन्हें 120 योग्य मासिक भुगतान के बाद अपने ऋण माफ करवाने चाहिए।

segments.src: In practice, tracking those 120 payments across different loan servicers, repayment plans, and employment records has proven anything but simple — and the Education Department says a chunk of the credit borrowers were given in recent years does not hold up under closer review.
segments.tr: व्यावहारिक रूप से, विभिन्न ऋण सेवा प्रदाताओं, पुनर्भुगतान योजनाओं और रोजगार रिकॉर्ड में उन 120 भुगतानों को ट्रैक करना बिल्कुल भी सरल नहीं रहा है — और शिक्षा विभाग का कहना है कि हाल के वर्षों में उधारकर्ताओं को जो क्रेडिट दिया गया था, उसका एक हिस्सा गहन समीक्षा के बाद सही नहीं पाया गया है।

segments.src: According to the department, corrections now being made to borrower accounts stem from a handful of recurring counting errors rather than a single sweeping policy reversal.
segments.tr: विभाग के अनुसार, उधारकर्ता खातों में अब किए जा रहे सुधार किसी एक व्यापक नीति के उलटफेर के बजाय बार-बार होने वाली कुछ गिनती की त्रुटियों के कारण हैं।

segments.src: Understanding what those errors are — and what they mean for someone checking their own loan dashboard — is more useful than treating the headlines as a verdict on any one borrower's progress.
segments.tr: वे त्रुटियां क्या हैं — और किसी उधारकर्ता के लिए अपने स्वयं के ऋण डैशबोर्ड की जांच करने का क्या मतलब है — इसे समझना किसी एक उधारकर्ता की प्रगति पर सुर्खियों को फैसला मानने से कहीं अधिक उपयोगी है।

segments.src: ## Where the Errors Reportedly Came From
segments.tr: ## त्रुटियां कथित तौर पर कहाँ से आईं

segments.src: Loan servicing records point to three broad categories of mistakes that inflated payment counts during the program's rapid expansion:
segments.tr: ऋण सेवा रिकॉर्ड गलतियों की तीन व्यापक श्रेणियों की ओर इशारा करते हैं जिन्होंने कार्यक्रम के तेजी से विस्तार के दौरान भुगतान गणना को बढ़ा दिया था:

segments.src: 1. **Forbearance and deferment periods counted as payments.** Some months when borrowers were not actually required to pay — because they were steered into forbearance or certain deferment statuses — were still logged as qualifying months. Regulators and consumer advocates flagged this "forbearance steering" problem in earlier reviews of student loan servicing broadly, and officials say some of that residue carried into PSLF tallies.
segments.tr: 1. **फॉरबेरेंस और आस्थगन (deferment) की अवधि को भुगतान के रूप में गिना गया।** कुछ महीने जब उधारकर्ताओं को वास्तव में भुगतान करने की आवश्यकता नहीं थी — क्योंकि उन्हें फॉरबेरेंस या कुछ आस्थगन स्थितियों में डाल दिया गया था — उन्हें अभी भी योग्य महीनों के रूप में दर्ज किया गया था। नियामकों और उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ताओं ने छात्र ऋण सेवा की व्यापक समीक्षाओं में इस "फॉरबेरेंस स्टीयरिंग" समस्या को चिह्नित किया था, और अधिकारियों का कहना है कि उस अवशेष का कुछ हिस्सा PSLF गणनाओं में आ गया।

segments.src: 2. **Repayment-plan mismatches.** PSLF only counts payments made under qualifying plans, generally income-driven repayment or the standard 10-year plan. When borrowers moved between plans — sometimes automatically, sometimes at a servicer's suggestion — a portion of months were credited that shouldn't have been under the program's rules.
segments.tr: 2. **पुनर्भुगतान-योजना बेमेल।** PSLF केवल योग्य योजनाओं के तहत किए गए भुगतानों को गिनता है, आमतौर पर आय-संचालित पुनर्भुगतान या मानक 10-वर्षीय योजना। जब उधारकर्ता योजनाओं के बीच चले गए — कभी-कभी स्वचालित रूप से, कभी-कभी सेवा प्रदाता के सुझाव पर — तो महीनों का एक हिस्सा क्रेडिट कर दिया गया जो कार्यक्रम के नियमों के तहत नहीं होना चाहिए था।

segments.src: 3. **Employer certification and consolidation timing issues.** Consolidating multiple federal loans can reset a payment count unless handled carefully, and employer certifications that overlapped or contained gaps sometimes produced credit for periods that do not actually meet the program's continuous full-time employment standard.
segments.tr: 3. **नियोक्ता प्रमाणन और समेकन समय की समस्याएं।** कई संघीय ऋणों को समेकित करने से भुगतान गणना रीसेट हो सकती है जब तक कि सावधानी से न संभाला जाए, और नियोक्ता प्रमाणन जो ओवरलैप होते थे या जिनमें अंतराल थे, कभी-कभी उन अवधियों के लिए क्रेडिट उत्पन्न करते थे जो वास्तव में कार्यक्रम के निरंतर पूर्णकालिक रोजगार मानक को पूरा नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: Officials describe these as data and processing issues compounded by the sheer volume of applications processed after temporary waivers expanded PSLF eligibility a few years ago, rather than an attempt to strip borrowers of credit they legitimately earned.
segments.tr: अधिकारी इन्हें डेटा और प्रसंस्करण संबंधी समस्याएं बताते हैं जो कुछ साल पहले अस्थायी छूट द्वारा PSLF पात्रता का विस्तार करने के बाद संसाधित आवेदनों की भारी मात्रा के कारण और जटिल हो गई थीं, न कि उधारकर्ताओं से उनके द्वारा वैध रूप से अर्जित क्रेडिट को छीनने का प्रयास।

segments.src: ## What It Means for Borrowers
segments.tr: ## उधारकर्ताओं के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: For most people enrolled in PSLF, this is unlikely to mean starting over.
segments.tr: PSLF में नामांकित अधिकांश लोगों के लिए, इसका मतलब फिर से शुरुआत करना नहीं है।

segments.src: The department has indicated that corrections apply to a subset of accounts where specific errors were identified, not to every borrower's count.
segments.tr: विभाग ने संकेत दिया है कि सुधार खातों के एक उपसमुच्चय पर लागू होते हैं जहां विशिष्ट त्रुटियों की पहचान की गई थी, न कि हर उधारकर्ता की गणना पर।

segments.src: Still, uncertainty itself is a real cost: borrowers who believed they were close to their 120th payment may find their online tracker shows fewer qualifying months than before, and that can complicate financial planning, job decisions, or timing around other debt.
segments.tr: फिर भी, अनिश्चितता अपने आप में एक वास्तविक लागत है: जो उधारकर्ता मानते थे कि वे अपने 120वें भुगतान के करीब थे, वे पा सकते हैं कि उनका ऑनलाइन ट्रैकर पहले की तुलना में कम योग्य महीने दिखाता है, और यह वित्तीय योजना, नौकरी के निर्णयों या अन्य ऋण के समय को जटिल बना सकता है।

segments.src: Consumer advocates recommend borrowers take a few concrete steps rather than assume the worst:
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ता सलाह देते हैं कि उधारकर्ता सबसे खराब स्थिति मानने के बजाय कुछ ठोस कदम उठाएं:

segments.src: - **Check your official PSLF count** through the Federal Student Aid dashboard, and compare it against your own payment history if you've kept records.
segments.tr: - **अपनी आधिकारिक PSLF गणना की जांच करें** फेडरल स्टूडेंट एड डैशबोर्ड के माध्यम से, और यदि आपने रिकॉर्ड रखा है तो अपने स्वयं के भुगतान इतिहास के साथ इसकी तुलना करें।

segments.src: - **Save documentation** of employer certifications, pay stubs, and correspondence with your servicer — these matter most if you need to dispute a change.
segments.tr: - **दस्तावेज़ीकरण सहेजें** नियोक्ता प्रमाणन, वेतन पर्ची, और अपने सेवा प्रदाता के साथ पत्राचार का — यदि आपको किसी बदलाव पर विवाद करने की आवश्यकता है तो ये सबसे अधिक मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: - **Contact your loan servicer directly** if your count drops unexpectedly, and ask specifically which months were affected and why.
segments.tr: - **सीधे अपने ऋण सेवा प्रदाता से संपर्क करें** यदि आपकी गणना अप्रत्याशित रूप से गिरती है, और विशेष रूप से पूछें कि कौन से महीने प्रभावित हुए थे और क्यों।

segments.src: - **Watch for official communications** from the Education Department or your servicer rather than relying solely on social media summaries, since the details of any correction process can change as it's implemented.
segments.tr: - **आधिकारिक संचार पर नज़र रखें** शिक्षा विभाग या अपने सेवा प्रदाता से, केवल सोशल मीडिया सारांशों पर भरोसा करने के बजाय, क्योंकि किसी भी सुधार प्रक्रिया का विवरण लागू होने के साथ बदल सकता है।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: PSLF has been recalibrated more than once since it was created in 2007, including a temporary limited waiver during the pandemic era that allowed many previously ineligible payments to count.
segments.tr: 2007 में बनाए जाने के बाद से PSLF को एक से अधिक बार पुनर्गठित किया गया है, जिसमें महामारी के दौर में एक अस्थायी सीमित छूट भी शामिल है जिसने कई पहले अयोग्य भुगतानों को गिनने की अनुमति दी थी।

segments.src: Corrections like these are, in part, the flip side of that expansion — a system that quickly granted broad credit is now being reconciled against the program's original rules.
segments.tr: इस तरह के सुधार, आंशिक रूप से, उस विस्तार का दूसरा पहलू हैं — एक प्रणाली जिसने तेजी से व्यापक क्रेडिट दिया था, अब कार्यक्रम के मूल नियमों के खिलाफ सामंजस्य बिठाया जा रहा है।

segments.src: For borrowers, the practical takeaway is patience paired with vigilance: verify your own numbers where possible, keep paperwork, and treat any change to your count as a starting point for a conversation with your servicer rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: उधारकर्ताओं के लिए, व्यावहारिक निष्कर्ष सतर्कता के साथ धैर्य रखना है: जहां संभव हो अपनी संख्याओं को सत्यापित करें, कागजी कार्रवाई रखें, और अपनी गणना में किसी भी बदलाव को अंतिम उत्तर के बजाय अपने सेवा प्रदाता के साथ बातचीत के शुरुआती बिंदु के रूप में मानें।

segments.src: As the department continues reviewing accounts, more specifics are expected to emerge about how many borrowers are affected and what appeal options exist for those who believe their credit was corrected in error.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे विभाग खातों की समीक्षा जारी रखेगा, इस बारे में अधिक विवरण सामने आने की उम्मीद है कि कितने उधारकर्ता प्रभावित हुए हैं और उन लोगों के लिए क्या अपील विकल्प मौजूद हैं जो मानते हैं कि उनका क्रेडिट गलती से सुधारा गया था।

es.title: Tres Errores, Millones de Prestatarios: Qué Hay Detrás de la Reversión del Crédito del Perdón de Préstamos por Servicio Público

segments.src: ## A Program Built on Counting Correctly
segments.tr: ## Un Programa Basado en Contar Correctamente

segments.src: Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) has always hinged on one simple-sounding task: counting payments.
segments.tr: El Perdón de Préstamos por Servicio Público (PSLF, por sus siglas en inglés) siempre ha dependido de una tarea que suena sencilla: contar pagos.

segments.src: Borrowers who work full-time for a qualifying government or nonprofit employer are supposed to have their loans forgiven after 120 qualifying monthly payments.
segments.tr: Se supone que los prestatarios que trabajan a tiempo completo para un empleador calificado del gobierno o sin fines de lucro deben recibir el perdón de sus préstamos después de 120 pagos mensuales elegibles.

segments.src: In practice, tracking those 120 payments across different loan servicers, repayment plans, and employment records has proven anything but simple — and the Education Department says a chunk of the credit borrowers were given in recent years does not hold up under closer review.
segments.tr: En la práctica, rastrear esos 120 pagos a través de diferentes administradores de préstamos, planes de pago y registros de empleo ha resultado ser cualquier cosa menos simple, y el Departamento de Educación dice que una parte del crédito otorgado a los prestatarios en los últimos años no se sostiene bajo una revisión más detallada.

segments.src: According to the department, corrections now being made to borrower accounts stem from a handful of recurring counting errors rather than a single sweeping policy reversal.
segments.tr: Según el departamento, las correcciones que ahora se están realizando en las cuentas de los prestatarios se deben a un puñado de errores de conteo recurrentes en lugar de a un único cambio radical de política.

segments.src: Understanding what those errors are — and what they mean for someone checking their own loan dashboard — is more useful than treating the headlines as a verdict on any one borrower's progress.
segments.tr: Entender cuáles son esos errores —y qué significan para alguien que revisa su propio panel de control de préstamos— es más útil que tratar los titulares como un veredicto sobre el progreso de cualquier prestatario en particular.

segments.src: ## Where the Errors Reportedly Came From
segments.tr: ## De Dónde Provinieron los Errores Según los Informes

segments.src: Loan servicing records point to three broad categories of mistakes that inflated payment counts during the program's rapid expansion:
segments.tr: Los registros de administración de préstamos apuntan a tres amplias categorías de errores que inflaron los conteos de pagos durante la rápida expansión del programa:

segments.src: 1. **Forbearance and deferment periods counted as payments.** Some months when borrowers were not actually required to pay — because they were steered into forbearance or certain deferment statuses — were still logged as qualifying months. Regulators and consumer advocates flagged this "forbearance steering" problem in earlier reviews of student loan servicing broadly, and officials say some of that residue carried into PSLF tallies.
segments.tr: 1. **Períodos de aplazamiento (forbearance y deferment) contados como pagos.** Algunos meses en los que a los prestatarios en realidad no se les exigía pagar —porque fueron dirigidos hacia el aplazamiento (forbearance) o ciertos estados de suspensión temporal (deferment)— aún se registraron como meses elegibles. Los reguladores y los defensores de los consumidores señalaron este problema de "dirección hacia el aplazamiento" en revisiones anteriores de la administración de préstamos estudiantiles en general, y los funcionarios dicen que parte de ese residuo se trasladó a los conteos del PSLF.

segments.src: 2. **Repayment-plan mismatches.** PSLF only counts payments made under qualifying plans, generally income-driven repayment or the standard 10-year plan. When borrowers moved between plans — sometimes automatically, sometimes at a servicer's suggestion — a portion of months were credited that shouldn't have been under the program's rules.
segments.tr: 2. **Desajustes en los planes de pago.** El PSLF solo cuenta los pagos realizados bajo planes elegibles, generalmente el pago basado en los ingresos o el plan estándar de 10 años. Cuando los prestatarios cambiaban de plan —a veces automáticamente, a veces por sugerencia del administrador— se acreditó una porción de meses que no debería haber sido elegible según las reglas del programa.

segments.src: 3. **Employer certification and consolidation timing issues.** Consolidating multiple federal loans can reset a payment count unless handled carefully, and employer certifications that overlapped or contained gaps sometimes produced credit for periods that do not actually meet the program's continuous full-time employment standard.
segments.tr: 3. **Problemas de sincronización en la certificación de empleadores y la consolidación.** Consolidar múltiples préstamos federales puede restablecer el conteo de pagos a menos que se maneje con cuidado, y las certificaciones de empleadores que se superponían o contenían vacíos a veces producían crédito por períodos que en realidad no cumplen con el estándar del programa de empleo continuo a tiempo completo.

segments.src: Officials describe these as data and processing issues compounded by the sheer volume of applications processed after temporary waivers expanded PSLF eligibility a few years ago, rather than an attempt to strip borrowers of credit they legitimately earned.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios describen estos problemas como cuestiones de datos y procesamiento agravadas por el gran volumen de solicitudes procesadas después de que las exenciones temporales ampliaron la elegibilidad para el PSLF hace unos años, en lugar de un intento de despojar a los prestatarios del crédito que ganaron legítimamente.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Borrowers
segments.tr: ## Qué Significa para los Prestatarios

segments.src: For most people enrolled in PSLF, this is unlikely to mean starting over.
segments.tr: Para la mayoría de las personas inscritas en el PSLF, es poco probable que esto signifique empezar de cero.

segments.src: The department has indicated that corrections apply to a subset of accounts where specific errors were identified, not to every borrower's count.
segments.tr: El departamento ha indicado que las correcciones se aplican a un subconjunto de cuentas donde se identificaron errores específicos, no al conteo de todos los prestatarios.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty itself is a real cost: borrowers who believed they were close to their 120th payment may find their online tracker shows fewer qualifying months than before, and that can complicate financial planning, job decisions, or timing around other debt.
segments.tr: Aun así, la incertidumbre en sí misma es un costo real: los prestatarios que creían estar cerca de su pago número 120 pueden encontrar que su rastreador en línea muestra menos meses elegibles que antes, y eso puede complicar la planificación financiera, las decisiones laborales o la sincronización en torno a otras deudas.

segments.src: Consumer advocates recommend borrowers take a few concrete steps rather than assume the worst:
segments.tr: Los defensores de los consumidores recomiendan que los prestatarios sigan algunos pasos concretos en lugar de asumir lo peor:

segments.src: - **Check your official PSLF count** through the Federal Student Aid dashboard, and compare it against your own payment history if you've kept records.
segments.tr: - **Revisa tu conteo oficial de PSLF** a través del panel de control de Ayuda Federal para Estudiantes (Federal Student Aid) y compáralo con tu propio historial de pagos si has guardado registros.

segments.src: ## A Program Built on Counting Correctly
segments.tr: ## A Program Built on Counting Correctly

segments.src: Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) has always hinged on one simple-sounding task: counting payments.
segments.tr: اعتمد برنامج الإعفاء من القروض الخدمية العامة (PSLF) دائمًا على مهمة تبدو بسيطة: حساب المدفوعات.

segments.src: Borrowers who work full-time for a qualifying government or nonprofit employer are supposed to have their loans forgiven after 120 qualifying monthly payments.
segments.tr: من المفترض أن يتم إعفاء المقترضين الذين يعملون بدوام كامل لصالح جهة حكومية أو غير ربحية مؤهلة بعد 120 دفعة شهرية مؤهلة.

segments.src: In practice, tracking those 120 payments across different loan servicers, repayment plans, and employment records has proven anything but simple — and the Education Department says a chunk of the credit borrowers were given in recent years does not hold up under closer review.
segments.tr: في الممارسة العملية، ثبت أن تتبع تلك الدفوعات الـ 120 عبر جهات خدمة القروض المختلفة، وخطط السداد، وسجلات العمل ليس بالأمر البسيط على الإطلاق - وتقول وزارة التعليم إن جزءًا من رصيد المقترضين الذي تم منحهم إياه في السنوات الأخيرة لا يثبت صحته عند المراجعة الدقيقة.

segments.src: According to the department, corrections now being made to borrower accounts stem from a handful of recurring counting errors rather than a single sweeping policy reversal.
segments.tr: وفقًا للوزارة، فإن التصحيحات التي يتم إجراؤها الآن على حسابات المقترضين تنبع من عدد قليل من أخطاء العد المتكررة وليس من انعكاس سياسة شاملة واحدة.

segments.src: Understanding what those errors are — and what they mean for someone checking their own loan dashboard — is more useful than treating the headlines as a verdict on any one borrower's progress.
segments.tr: إن فهم ما هي تلك الأخطاء - وما تعنيه لشخص يراجع لوحة معلومات القروض الخاصة به - يعد أكثر فائدة من التعامل مع العناوين الرئيسية باعتبارها حكمًا على تقدم أي مقترض.

segments.src: ## Where the Errors Reportedly Came From
segments.tr: ## Where the Errors Reportedly Came From

segments.src: Loan servicing records point to three broad categories of mistakes that inflated payment counts during the program's rapid expansion:
segments.tr: تشير سجلات خدمة القروض إلى ثلاث فئات واسعة من الأخطاء التي تضخمت فيها أعداد المدفوعات أثناء التوسع السريع للبرنامج:

segments.src: 1. **Forbearance and deferment periods counted as payments.** Some months when borrowers were not actually required to pay — because they were steered into forbearance or certain deferment statuses — were still logged as qualifying months. Regulators and consumer advocates flagged this "forbearance steering" problem in earlier reviews of student loan servicing broadly, and officials say some of that residue carried into PSLF tallies.
segments.tr: 1. **فترات تأجيل السداد والوقف المؤقت محسوبة كمدفوعات.** بعض الشهور التي لم يُطلب فيها من المقترضين فعليًا الدفع - لأنهم تم توجيههم إلى الوقف المؤقت أو حالات تأجيل معينة - تم تسجيلها مع ذلك كشهور مؤهلة. وقد أشار المنظمون والمدافعون عن المستهلكين إلى مشكلة "توجيه الوقف المؤقت" هذه في المراجعات السابقة لخدمة قروض الطلاب بشكل عام، ويقول المسؤولون إن بعض مخلفات ذلك انتقلت إلى إحصاءات PSLF.

segments.src: 2. **Repayment-plan mismatches.** PSLF only counts payments made under qualifying plans, generally income-driven repayment or the standard 10-year plan. When borrowers moved between plans — sometimes automatically, sometimes at a servicer's suggestion — a portion of months were credited that shouldn't have been under the program's rules.
segments.tr: 2. **عدم تطابق خطط السداد.** يحسب برنامج PSLF فقط المدفوعات التي يتم إجراؤها بموجب خطط مؤهلة، وعمومًا السداد المرتبط بالدخل أو خطة ال10 سنوات القياسية. عندما انتقل المقترضون بين الخطط - أحيانًا تلقائيًا، وأحيانًا بناءً على اقتراح من جهة الخدمة - تم إضافة جزء من الأشهر التي لم يكن ينبغي احتسابها بموجب قواعد البرنامج.

segments.src: 3. **Employer certification and consolidation timing issues.** Consolidating multiple federal loans can reset a payment count unless handled carefully, and employer certifications that overlapped or contained gaps sometimes produced credit for periods that do not actually meet the program's continuous full-time employment standard.
segments.tr: 3. **مشكلات توقيت توثيق صاحب العمل والدمج.** يمكن أن يؤدي دمج قروض اتحادية متعددة إلى إعادة تعيين عدد المدفوعات ما لم يتم التعامل مع الأمر بحذر، وأحيانًا تنتج عن شهادات أصحاب العمل المتداخلة أو التي تحتوي على فترات توقف رصيدًا لفترات لا تتوافق في الواقع مع معيار العمل المستمر بدوام كامل للبرنامج.

segments.src: Officials describe these as data and processing issues compounded by the sheer volume of applications processed after temporary waivers expanded PSLF eligibility a few years ago, rather than an attempt to strip borrowers of credit they legitimately earned.
segments.tr: يصف المسؤولون هذه بأنها مشكلات تتعلق بالبيانات والمعالجة تفاقمت بسبب الحجم الهائل للطلبات التي تمت معالجتها بعد أن وسعت التنازلات المؤقتة أهلية PSLF قبل بضع سنوات، وليس محاولة لتجريد المقترضين من الرصيد الذي اكتسبوه بشكل مشروع.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Borrowers
segments.tr: ## What It Means for Borrowers

segments.src: For most people enrolled in PSLF, this is unlikely to mean starting over.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لمعظم الأشخاص المسجلين في PSLF، من غير المرجح أن يعني هذا البدء من جديد.

segments.src: The department has indicated that corrections apply to a subset of accounts where specific errors were identified, not to every borrower's count.
segments.tr: أشارت الوزارة إلى أن التصحيحات تنطبق على مجموعة فرعية من الحسابات التي تم تحديد أخطاء محددة فيها، وليس على عدد كل مقترض.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty itself is a real cost: borrowers who believed they were close to their 120th payment may find their online tracker shows fewer qualifying months than before, and that can complicate financial planning, job decisions, or timing around other debt.
segments.tr: مع ذلك، فإن عدم اليقين بحد ذاته يعد تكلفة حقيقية: فالمقترضون الذين اعتقدوا أنهم يقتربون من الدفعة رقم 120 قد يكتشفون أن متعقبهم عبر الإنترنت يظهر شهورًا مؤهلة أقل من ذي قبل، وهذا يمكن أن يعقد التخطيط المالي، أو قرارات الوظيفة، أو توقيت الديون الأخرى.

segments.src: Consumer advocates recommend borrowers take a few concrete steps rather than assume the worst:
segments.tr: يوصي المدافعون عن المستهلك بأن يتخذ المقترضون بضع خطوات ملموسة بدلاً من توقع الأسوأ:

segments.src: - **Check your official PSLF count** through the Federal Student Aid dashboard, and compare it against your own payment history if you've kept records.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من عداد PSLF الرسمي الخاص بك** من خلال لوحة معلومات المساعدة الفيدرالية للطلاب، وقارنه بسجل الدفع الخاص بك إذا احتفظت بسجلات.

segments.src: - **Save documentation** of employer certifications, pay stubs, and correspondence with your servicer — these matter most if you need to dispute a change.
segments.tr: - **احفظ الوثائق** الخاصة بشهادات أصحاب العمل، وقسائم الرواتب، والمراسلات مع جهة خدمة القروض الخاصة بك - فهذه هي الأهم إذا كنت بحاجة إلى الاعتراض على التغيير.

segments.src: - **Contact your loan servicer directly** if your count drops unexpectedly, and ask specifically which months were affected and why.
segments.tr: - **اتصل بجهة خدمة القروض الخاصة بك مباشرة** إذا انخفض عدادك بشكل غير متوقع، واسأل على وجه تحديد عن الأشهر التي تأثرت ولماذا.

segments.src: - **Watch for official communications** from the Education Department or your servicer rather than relying solely on social media summaries, since the details of any correction process can change as it's implemented.
segments.tr: - **ترقب الاتصالات الرسمية** من وزارة التعليم أو جهة خدمة القروض الخاصة بك بدلاً من الاعتماد فقط على ملخصات وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، حيث إن تفاصيل أي عملية تصحيح يمكن أن تتغير أثناء تنفيذها.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## The Bigger Picture

segments.src: PSLF has been recalibrated more than once since it was created in 2007, including a temporary limited waiver during the pandemic era that allowed many previously ineligible payments to count.
segments.tr: تم إعادة معايرة PSLF أكثر من مرة منذ إنشائه في عام 2007، بما في ذلك إعفاء محدود مؤقت خلال عصر الجائحة والذي سمح باحتساب العديد من المدفوعات غير المؤهلة سابقًا.

segments.src: Corrections like these are, in part, the flip side of that expansion — a system that quickly granted broad credit is now being reconciled against the program's original rules.
segments.tr: إن التصحيحات من هذا القبيل هي، جزئيًا، الوجه الآخر لهذا التوسع - فالنظام الذي منح رصيدًا واسعًا بسرعة يتم الآن مراجعته مقابل قواعد البرنامج الأصلية.

segments.src: For borrowers, the practical takeaway is patience paired with vigilance: verify your own numbers where possible, keep paperwork, and treat any change to your count as a starting point for a conversation with your servicer rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمقترضين، فإن الخلاصة العملية هي الصبر المقترن اليقظة: تحقق من أرقامك الخاصة حيثما أمكن، واحتفظ بالأوراق، وتَعامل مع أي تغيير في عدادك باعتباره نقطة بداية لمحادثة مع جهة خدمة القروض الخاصة بك بدلاً من كونها إجابة نهائية.

segments.src: As the department continues reviewing accounts, more specifics are expected to emerge about how many borrowers are affected and what appeal options exist for those who believe their credit was corrected in error.
segments.tr: مع استمرار الوزارة في مراجعة الحسابات، من المتوقع ظهور المزيد من التفاصيل حول عدد المقترضين المتضررين وما هي خيارات الاستئناف المتاحة لأولئك الذين يعتقدون أنه تم تصحيح رصيدهم عن طريق الخطأ.

segments.src: ## A Program Built on Counting Correctly
segments.tr: ## Un programme fondé sur un comptage précis

segments.src: Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) has always hinged on one simple-sounding task: counting payments.
segments.tr: Le programme de remise de prêt au titre du service public (PSLF) a toujours reposé sur une tâche qui semble simple : compter les paiements.

segments.src: Borrowers who work full-time for a qualifying government or nonprofit employer are supposed to have their loans forgiven after 120 qualifying monthly payments.
segments.tr: Les emprunteurs qui travaillent à temps plein pour un employeur gouvernemental ou à but non lucratif admissible sont censés voir leurs prêts annulés après 120 paiements mensuels admissibles.

segments.src: In practice, tracking those 120 payments across different loan servicers, repayment plans, and employment records has proven anything but simple — and the Education Department says a chunk of the credit borrowers were given in recent years does not hold up under closer review.
segments.tr: En pratique, le suivi de ces 120 paiements auprès de différents gestionnaires de prêts, plans de remboursement et dossiers d'emploi s'est avéré tout sauf simple — et le ministère de l'Éducation affirme qu'une partie des crédits accordés aux emprunteurs ces dernières années ne résiste pas à un examen plus approfondi.

segments.src: According to the department, corrections now being made to borrower accounts stem from a handful of recurring counting errors rather than a single sweeping policy reversal.
segments.tr: Selon le ministère, les corrections actuellement apportées aux comptes des emprunteurs découlent d'une série d'erreurs de comptage récurrentes plutôt que d'un revirement politique généralisé.

segments.src: Understanding what those errors are — and what they mean for someone checking their own loan dashboard — is more useful than treating the headlines as a verdict on any one borrower's progress.
segments.tr: Comprendre la nature de ces erreurs — et ce qu'elles signifient pour une personne consultant son propre tableau de bord de prêt — est plus utile que de considérer les gros titres comme un verdict sur la progression de chaque emprunteur.

segments.src: ## Where the Errors Reportedly Came From
segments.tr: ## D'où proviennent les erreurs signalées

segments.src: Loan servicing records point to three broad categories of mistakes that inflated payment counts during the program's rapid expansion:
segments.tr: Les dossiers de gestion des prêts indiquent trois grandes catégories d'erreurs ayant gonflé le nombre de paiements lors de l'expansion rapide du programme :

segments.src: 1. **Forbearance and deferment periods counted as payments.** Some months when borrowers were not actually required to pay — because they were steered into forbearance or certain deferment statuses — were still logged as qualifying months. Regulators and consumer advocates flagged this "forbearance steering" problem in earlier reviews of student loan servicing broadly, and officials say some of that residue carried into PSLF tallies.
segments.tr: 1. **Les périodes de report et de différé comptées comme des paiements.** Certains mois où les emprunteurs n'étaient pas réellement tenus de payer — parce qu'ils ont été orientés vers un report ou certains statuts de différé — ont tout de même été enregistrés comme des mois admissibles. Les régulateurs et les défenseurs des consommateurs ont signalé ce problème de « pilotage vers le report » lors d'examens antérieurs de la gestion des prêts étudiants en général, et les responsables affirment qu'une partie de ces résidus s'est retrouvée dans les décomptes du PSLF.

segments.src: 2. **Repayment-plan mismatches.** PSLF only counts payments made under qualifying plans, generally income-driven repayment or the standard 10-year plan. When borrowers moved between plans — sometimes automatically, sometimes at a servicer's suggestion — a portion of months were credited that shouldn't have been under the program's rules.
segments.tr: 2. **Inadéquations des plans de remboursement.** Le PSLF ne comptabilise que les paiements effectués dans le cadre de plans admissibles, généralement des plans de remboursement basés sur le revenu ou le plan standard de 10 ans. Lorsque les emprunteurs changeaient de plan — parfois automatiquement, parfois sur suggestion d'un gestionnaire — une partie des mois a été créditée alors qu'elle n'aurait pas dû l'être selon les règles du programme.

segments.src: 3. **Employer certification and consolidation timing issues.** Consolidating multiple federal loans can reset a payment count unless handled carefully, and employer certifications that overlapped or contained gaps sometimes produced credit for periods that do not actually meet the program's continuous full-time employment standard.
segments.tr: 3. **Problèmes de certification de l'employeur et de calendrier de consolidation.** La consolidation de plusieurs prêts fédéraux peut réinitialiser un décompte de paiements si elle n'est pas gérée avec soin, et les certifications d'employeur qui se chevauchaient ou contenaient des lacunes ont parfois généré des crédits pour des périodes qui ne répondent pas réellement à la norme d'emploi à temps plein continu du programme.

segments.src: Officials describe these as data and processing issues compounded by the sheer volume of applications processed after temporary waivers expanded PSLF eligibility a few years ago, rather than an attempt to strip borrowers of credit they legitimately earned.
segments.tr: Les responsables décrivent ces problèmes comme des questions de données et de traitement aggravées par le volume considérable de demandes traitées après que des dérogations temporaires ont élargi l'admissibilité au PSLF il y a quelques années, plutôt que comme une tentative de priver les emprunteurs de crédits légitimement acquis.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Borrowers
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les emprunteurs

segments.src: For most people enrolled in PSLF, this is unlikely to mean starting over.
segments.tr: Pour la plupart des personnes inscrites au PSLF, cela ne signifie probablement pas un retour à la case départ.

segments.src: The department has indicated that corrections apply to a subset of accounts where specific errors were identified, not to every borrower's count.
segments.tr: Le ministère a indiqué que les corrections s'appliquent à un sous-ensemble de comptes où des erreurs spécifiques ont été identifiées, et non au décompte de chaque emprunteur.

segments.src: Still, uncertainty itself is a real cost: borrowers who believed they were close to their 120th payment may find their online tracker shows fewer qualifying months than before, and that can complicate financial planning, job decisions, or timing around other debt.
segments.tr: Néanmoins, l'incertitude elle-même représente un coût réel : les emprunteurs qui pensaient être proches de leur 120e paiement pourraient constater que leur suivi en ligne affiche moins de mois admissibles qu'auparavant, ce qui peut compliquer la planification financière, les décisions professionnelles ou le calendrier concernant d'autres dettes.

segments.src: Consumer advocates recommend borrowers take a few concrete steps rather than assume the worst:
segments.tr: Les défenseurs des consommateurs recommandent aux emprunteurs de prendre quelques mesures concrètes plutôt que de supposer le pire :

segments.src: - **Check your official PSLF count** through the Federal Student Aid dashboard, and compare it against your own payment history if you've kept records.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez votre décompte PSLF officiel** via le tableau de bord de l'aide fédérale aux étudiants (Federal Student Aid), et comparez-le à votre propre historique de paiement si vous avez conservé des dossiers.

segments.src: - **Save documentation** of employer certifications, pay stubs, and correspondence with your servicer — these matter most if you need to dispute a change.
segments.tr: - **Conservez les documents** relatifs aux certifications d'employeur, aux fiches de paie et à la correspondance avec votre gestionnaire — ils sont essentiels si vous devez contester un changement.
